NotoMono-Regular.ttf
--------------------

Source: Google Noto Fonts (Monospace family), downloaded from the Debian
package fonts-noto-core (/usr/share/fonts/truetype/noto/).

Copyright 2007 Google Inc. All Rights Reserved.

Licensed under the SIL Open Font License, Version 1.1 (OFL-1.1):
https://openfontlicense.org — the license text is at
https://github.com/notofonts/notofonts.github.io/blob/main/fonts/LICENSE.

Why this file is checked in: the ASS renderer tests (test_ass_renderer.cpp)
need glyph rendering to be deterministic on every machine — libass is
configured with ASS_FONTPROVIDER_NONE (no fontconfig, no system font
enumeration) and resolves its glyphs from this exact font, so CI runners
without any fonts installed render the same pixels as a desktop.

The font is a test fixture only; nothing ships it to end users.
